title: Google Drive File Storage: Complete Design
description: Design google drive file storage with OOP principles, class diagrams, and scalable C# implementations.

data.text: Design a google drive file storage using object-oriented principles. Focus on clean class design, proper encapsulation, and extensible architecture.

data.title: google-drive-storage.Advanced.cs — Processor Pipeline
Design Principles Applied
data.text: Use composition over inheritance. Keep entities simple. Use interfaces to decouple services from implementations. Apply CQRS when read and write patterns diverge.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Encapsulate state inside entities; expose behavior, not data
Strategy and Command patterns make behavior pluggable
Dependency injection keeps classes loosely coupled
data.takeaway: Google Drive File Storage demonstrates how clean OOP design leads to maintainable, testable code that can evolve with requirements.
